row_alignment.eligible_t: For each demo, integer t from 3 through T-1 inclusive.
row_alignment.label: The ten-dimensional debounced typed birth/death vector at state t; any-transition is its logical OR.
row_alignment.robot_state: Concatenate obs/ee_pos, obs/ee_ori, obs/gripper_states, and obs/joint_states at t-1.
row_alignment.oracle_boundary_subset: Retain row t iff any exact typed transition occurs at an index in [t-2,t+2] within the same demo.
row_alignment.oracle_contact_features: Use only the exact-t logical-OR and exact-t ten-dimensional typed vector, never a future/window aggregate.

visual_probe.image_tensor: Concatenate agent[t-1], agent[t], wrist[t-1], and wrist[t] as twelve channels after 64x64 area resize; scale uint8 to [-1,1]; no augmentation.
visual_probe.nonvisual_tensor: Robot state, two-action history, and normalized time, standardized using development_train statistics only.
visual_architecture: concatenate standardized nonvisual tensor, Linear-to-64, ReLU, Linear-to-11 logits
visual_probe.nonvisual_control: Standardized nonvisual tensor, Linear-to-64, ReLU, Linear-to-11 logits.
visual_probe.loss: Unweighted binary cross entropy with logits over any-transition plus ten typed bins.
visual_probe.selection: For each model and seed, select the epoch with highest pooled development_tune any-transition AUPRC; break ties toward the earlier epoch.
visual_probe.validation_summary: Report medians over the three frozen seeds for pooled and per-task validation metrics.
visual_probe.prevalence_control: Constant development-train any-transition prevalence score, evaluated on validation.
visual_probe.supported_typed_bins: Bins with at least ten positive rows on the full frozen panel, matching the Stage 0A support rule.
visual_probe.metric_edge_case: Average precision is zero when a reported slice has no positive target and one when all targets are positive.

oracle_action_headroom.base: Development-train-standardized robot state, two-action history, and normalized time.
oracle_action_headroom.gripper_stage_control: Base plus the action[t-1] gripper-sign change indicator and a four-bin one-hot temporal quartile.
oracle_action_headroom.strongest_control: Whichever augmented control has lower pooled development_tune NRMSE after its own alpha selection; break ties toward gripper_stage_control.
oracle_action_headroom.full: The strongest control plus the exact-t ten-dimensional typed transition vector.
oracle_action_headroom.estimator: Multi-output ridge. Fit X and each arm target dimension standardizers on development_train only; report RMSE in development-train-standardized arm units.
oracle_action_headroom.alpha_selection: Minimize pooled development_tune NRMSE; break ties toward the smaller alpha.
oracle_action_headroom.task_metric: Compute validation NRMSE separately per frozen validation task.
oracle_action_headroom.shuffle: For each of fifty root-seed-derived controls, independently permute exact-t typed vectors within each task-demo group in development_train, development_tune, and validation; reselect alpha on development_tune.
oracle_action_headroom.shuffle_fraction: Median over shuffles of (strongest validation NRMSE - shuffled validation NRMSE) divided by (strongest validation NRMSE - full validation NRMSE). A nonpositive full gain fails and has null fraction.
oracle_action_headroom.finite_fraction: Fraction of finite validation prediction scalars across the three real controls, full model, and all fifty shuffled models.

decision_logic.go: All visual and all oracle gates pass -> CONTACT_TOPOLOGY_PREMETHOD_STAGE0_GO.
decision_logic.trivial_equivalence: Valid execution with visual signal failing both nonvisual advantage gates, or oracle typed gain not exceeding its strongest control -> STAGE0_TRIVIAL_EQUIVALENCE.
decision_logic.no_headroom: Otherwise, any valid scientific gate failure -> STAGE0_NO_HEADROOM.
decision_logic.invalid: Any data-integrity, forbidden-access, nonfinite, implementation, or resource failure -> STAGE0_DATA_OR_SUPERVISION_FAILURE or STAGE0_IMPLEMENTATION_OR_RESOURCE_FAILURE as applicable.
